Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, struct, zlib
b=pathlib.Path('test_read_format_rar5_compressed.rar').read_bytes()
pos=8

def readvar_at(pos):
    res=0
    shift=0
    for i in range(8):
        c=b[pos+i]
        res += (c&0x7f) << shift
        if c&0x80==0:
            return res,i+1
        shift+=7
    return res,9
for h in range(5):
    print('pos',pos)
    crc=int.from_bytes(b[pos:pos+4],'little'); pos+=4
    raw,l=readvar_at(pos)
    hdr_size=raw+l
    comp=zlib.crc32(b[pos:pos+hdr_size])&0xffffffff
    print('crc',hex(crc),hex(comp),'raw',raw,'sizelen',l,'hdr_size',hdr_size,'hdrbytes',b[pos:pos+hdr_size].hex())
    hdr_start=pos
    pos+=l
    header_id,ln=readvar_at(pos); pos+=ln
    flags,ln=readvar_at(pos); pos+=ln
    print('id flags',header_id,hex(flags))
    if flags&1:
        extra,ln=readvar_at(pos); pos+=ln; print(' extra',extra)
    data_size=0
    if flags&2:
        data_size,ln=readvar_at(pos); pos+=ln; print(' data_size',data_size)
    print('body remaining in hdr', hdr_start+hdr_size-pos, b[pos:hdr_start+hdr_size].hex())
    # rudimentary parse file
    if header_id==2:
        q=pos
        def rv():
            global q
            v,ln=readvar_at(q); q+=ln; return v,ln
        for nm in ['file_flags','unpacked','file_attr','comp_info','host_os','name_size']:
            v,ln=rv(); print(' ',nm,v,'len',ln)
            if nm=='name_size':
                print(' name',b[q:q+v]); q+=v
                break
        print('file parsed q rem', q, hdr_start+hdr_size-q)
    pos=hdr_start+hdr_size
    if data_size:
        print('data at',pos,'len',data_size,'first',b[pos:pos+20].hex())
        pos+=data_size
PY
